52593769.text: Echo Station Five Seven. Walkers on the north ridge. Four of them.

1aaab673.text: A long time ago, in a galaxy far, far away.

6c1909d4.text: A droid carries a message across the sand.

ec255cc2.text: A farm boy looks to the horizon.

04849817.text: You need a ship? I have a ship.

05982520.text: Help us. You are our only hope.

1016d473.text: And an empire that rules by fear.

411dff85.text: I find your lack of faith disturbing.

12255f98.text: Copy, Rogue Leader. Hold them off the shield generator as long as you can.

e4d0c846.text: Rogue Group, form up on me. Attack pattern delta. Go now.

de20755f.text: That armour is too strong for blasters. Go for the legs.

41b81b4a.text: Rogue Three, set your harpoon. I will cover you.

ad76b478.text: The cable is holding. Once more round.

4ec79c2f.text: Rogue Two, I am hit. I am going in.

fdd27d93.text: Grab the line. I am going under it.

d193ac8f.text: The trench is lost. Fall back to the transports.

f79bbf3f.text: Echo Base, they have broken through. Begin the evacuation.

64b5836e.text: Over there. Two more of them.

89431dda.text: Keep on that one. I will take these two.

fade7aa1.text: Take the one on the left.

d53e487c.text: Oh dear. They have been gone a long time.
